sn1.36:1.3: The Pali text attributes none of the verses to the Buddha. However, in the two Chinese parallels at SA 1286 and SA-2 284, one deity gives an opening verse; the Buddha responds with a series of 5 or 6 verses; then the deity concludes with a verse in praise. This gives a much more satisfying structure, and it seems likely the Pali text has suffered serious loss.
sn1.36:2.1: This verse is attributed to the Buddha in the Chinese parallels.
sn1.36:4.4: While the deity is said to recite several verses, the Pali text finishes here with a close _-ti_ indicating the end of the quote.
